Is it time?

Signs you've outgrown your subscriptions

If three or more of these sound like your business, one owned system will probably save you money and time.

  • You pay for five or more appsEach with its own monthly fee, login and settings.
  • Costs rise with every new hirePer-user pricing makes growth more expensive.
  • Staff copy data between appsThe same customer typed into three places.
  • Reports need spreadsheetsNo single view of sales, jobs and stock.
  • You work around default settingsThe software decides how you work, not you.
  • A vendor changed price or featuresAnd you had no say in it.

How it works

From subscription review to handover

We deliver in stages, so you see working software early and can shape it as we go.

  1. Discovery

    We map how your business runs today and every subscription you pay for.

  2. Fixed written quote

    Scope, timeline and price in plain English, in AUD or USD.

  3. Build in stages

    You see working software early and give feedback as we go.

  4. Handover & training

    Source code, documentation and training for your team.

Pricing

What affects the cost of custom software

  • How many parts of your business the system covers (for example sales, jobs, stock and staff)
  • How many existing tools, files or databases we need to connect or migrate
  • Number of user types and the permissions each needs
  • Whether you need a mobile app, a customer portal, or both
  • Hosting, support and new features after launch (optional)

Every quote is itemised, in AUD or USD, and valid for 30 days.

Get a fixed quote

Getting started

What we'll need from you

  • A list of the apps and subscriptions you pay for today
  • A rough picture of how work moves through your business, from enquiry to invoice
  • Examples of the reports, forms and documents you use
  • Someone on your team who can answer questions and test as we build

Don't have all of this yet? That's fine. We'll work through it together in your free consultation.

FAQ

Custom software questions

How much does custom software cost?

Every project is quoted in writing, in AUD or USD, after a free consultation. Because you own the result, there are no per-user monthly licence fees.

How long does it take to build?

It depends on what the system needs to do. Your quote includes a timeline, and we deliver in stages so you can use parts of the system early.

Who owns the software?

You do. At handover you receive the full source code and documentation.

Who can maintain it?

It's built on standard, widely used technology, so any developer or your own team can maintain it. We also offer ongoing support if you'd like us to look after it.

Can it connect to tools we keep?

Yes. We integrate with accounting, payments, Microsoft 365 and other systems through APIs.

Can you move our data from our current apps?

Yes. Moving your existing customers, jobs, products and history into the new system is part of the project.

Is our data secure?

Yes. We build with multi-factor authentication, encryption, daily backups and Essential Eight aligned practices. We're an ASD Business Partner.

What happens after launch?

You can maintain the system yourself or with any developer, or keep us on for support, hosting and new features. It's your choice.

Is custom software only for big companies?

No. We price for small and mid-sized businesses. For many, one owned system costs less over time than the subscriptions it replaces.
